snippet.description:
Behind every rank, there are people who made the journey a little clearer.

This Teachers’ Day, hear directly from our toppers as they share the teachers and mentors who shaped their UPSC journey.

From making difficult subjects easier to understand to building confidence, improving answer writing and providing the right guidance at the right time, these are the people our toppers remember.

This one is for the teachers who made a difference.
